dialogue.user: The Miz Mooz Letty Loafers sound interesting. Can you tell me more about their comfort and style features? Also, how do they compare to the Cole Haan Oxfords in terms of ratings and reviews?
dialogue.agent:
The **Miz Mooz Women's Letty Loafer** shoes are priced at $149.95, have an average rating of 4.6 stars from 35 reviews, and are described as comfortable with a flexible sole. Here are some of the top reviews:

1. "These shoes are great—comfortable right out of the box even for problem feet like mine.. and they look classy and expensive. I have 3 pairs in blue, red, and green—all beautiful!! I am a teacher and on my feet all day—these are so comfortable and still very stylish and professional looking. I highly recommend them!"
2. "Love these shoes! They look just like the pictures, a classic shoe that can be worn both casually and to work. I just wore them for the first time, to work, where I do plenty of walking. They were comfortable as soon as I put them on, and got more comfortable throughout the day."
3. "The description of the lining as leather is accurate, but the lining stops part way into the shoe. The inside of the front of the shoe feels like paper. Whatever material typically goes between the lining and the upper, that's all there is (see pics). It feels like the shoe will fall apart if you sweat in them at all or the shoe gets wet. There's also a distinct line visible on the outside where the lining stops. Such a strange corners-cutting move. Makes the shoe feel cheap and fragile."

In comparison, the **Cole Haan Women's Oxford** shoes are priced at $100.00, have an average rating of 4.7 stars from 23 reviews, and are also described as comfortable with ZeroGrand technology for ultimate comfort. Here are some of the top reviews:

1. "In love with this model. they sent it in the estimated time, very comfortable and the color is exactly what I ordered."
2. "I wear these to walk back and forth to work (because they are more stylish than a traditional sneaker), but the truth is they can be worn anywhere, anytime.. They are so lightweight, you’ll think the box is empty before you open them. The support is perfect for any activity other than serious hiking. This is my 3rd pair."
3. "Me gusto el producto y la calidad. Me agrado y el color."

Both options have high ratings and positive reviews, but the Cole Haan Oxfords are slightly more affordable and also highly praised for their comfort and style.
